data.message: Fisher01–22,24–25: opt in individually to 18 tons; I commit to 18 even if others choose 10. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, above collapse threshold, but recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; nor is long-run optimality. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.

I propose 10 tons each this month: 25 × 10 = 250 caught, leaving 250, so the lake returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That yields $10,000 each per month sustainably. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; after catches are revealed, we can assess participation and adjust together.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher. With 25 of us, total catch is 250, leaving 250; either replenishment outcome then restores 500. Each earns $10,000/month indefinitely if we all comply. Larger catches risk undermining that reliable income. I intend to request 10 tons if discussion supports this plan; please state whether you will too.
